items.rationale: Covered under 5.2.6(b) and 7.1.1(b) as necessary to determine cause and extent of loss; reference cases 20 and 34 show this is always indemnified for a sudden burst. Policy sub-limit for assessment is EUR 3,000, but reference cases show fair market t per unit about 530.

Covered under 5.2.6(a) and 7.1.1(b) as necessary to locate the burst; reference cases 27 and 34 show this is always indemnified for a single burst. Policy sub-limit for leak location is EUR 1,000, but reference cases show t per unit about 567.
Covered under 5.2.6(a) as technician time for leak location; reference case 34 (2.5 hrs) shows t about 254 for this quantity.
Covered under 5.2.6(c) as the first vehicle charge on this invoice; capped at EUR 70 net plus VAT, but reference cases show market t per unit about 84 gross.
Ancillary site protection not specifically listed in 7.1.7 or 5.1; not a repair cost or necessary for reinstatement, and not indemnified in any reference case. Excluded by 7.1.8(b).

items.description: Floor covering removal – removal of linoleum incl. skirting and transport to the container 82.8 m²
items.rationale: Removal of affected floor covering is preparatory work under 7.1.7(a), but reference case 20 shows t for this line type is below 150, possibly 0, as the charge was found too high. Indemnified only up to a moderate market rate.

items.description: Preparation of floor surfaces for further processing 82.8 m²
items.rationale: Preparation of substrate is necessary before reinstatement (7.1.7(b)), but must be limited to the affected area. Reference cases suggest this is usually included in the removal line or modestly priced.

Debris removal is covered under 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a), but only one such charge per event is indemnified (7.1.8(c)). Reference cases show t per pc about 60. The first such charge (this one) is indemnified.

Labour for drying setup/removal is covered as part of necessary repair (7.1.7(b)), but reference cases show such hours are usually included in the drying lump sum or skilled worker lines. If not double-billed, indemnified at a moderate rate.

items.description: Dust protection incl. material and labor 10 m²
items.rationale: Dust protection is not specifically listed in 7.1.7, but may be necessary for safe drying work. Reference cases do not show separate indemnification, but a modest allowance is sometimes accepted.
Kitchen was not affected by water (description: 'kitchen stayed completely dry, no moisture readings there at all'), so this is unrelated to the damage and excluded by 7.1.5.

Drying of affected floor area is covered under 7.1.7(b), but reference case 20 (similar open-plan job) shows t for large-area drying was below 200, possibly 0, as the charge was found too high. Indemnified only up to a moderate market rate.

Cavity drying is covered under 7.1.7(b) if the cavity was reached by water (description: water ran out across the main open living area, so likely yes). Reference cases show cavity drying is usually included in the main drying charge, but a modest separate allowance may be accepted.
Labour for drying or reinstatement is covered under 7.1.7(b); reference cases show t per hr about 87, so for 4 hrs about 349.
First vehicle charge on this invoice is covered under 5.2.6(c), capped at EUR 70 net plus VAT, but reference cases show t per unit about 84 gross.
Second vehicle charge on the same invoice is excluded by 5.2.6(c) and 7.1.8(b); not indemnified in any reference case.
Second construction waste disposal charge for the same event is excluded by 7.1.8(c); only the first such charge is indemnified.
